decision: Conservative development-screen candidate, not a statistically established optimum
reasons: Keep E=0.45: independent labels do not identify a superior empirical weight; avoid optimizing popularity against itself.

Stage screening cannot establish whole-deck improvement; evaluate this frozen combination against baseline on held-out commanders next.
